whatIsIt.eli5: A gate that lets the group finder's knowledge flow into a spot of the network. It starts closed and learns how much to open.
whatIsIt.simple: Adds the HyperACE features into a point of the network: output = x + gate × y, where gate is one learned number that starts at 0.

whyExists.eli5: So every part of the model can use the shared knowledge, but only as much as helps.
whyExists.simple: FullPAD distributes the HyperACE features through three kinds of tunnels: backbone→neck, inside the neck, and neck→head. Starting the gate at 0 means training begins from the plain network.
whyExists.engineer: Full-Pipeline Aggregation-and-Distribution (paper §3.3) with zero-initialised scalar gating.

eli5: Add the shared notes, turned down by the gate.
simple: Both inputs must have the same size.
Multiply the HyperACE features by the gate.

example.eli5: YOLOv13n has 7 of these gates, each with just one learned number.
